scope: composeStudioGenerationPlanDraft extracted to a thin module with no align-board or sqlite imports. session-snapshot and StudioGenerationControlView expose the same read-only create_studio_generation_plan draft. Snapshot uses query.panelId only (does not guess the first panel) and only a persisted asset-binding-set pack whose target.panelId matches; unit-grid packs and unpersisted readiness candidates stay blocked. Control uses the selected panel's own ready pack and never the unit-grid history pack. Draft is omitted from session-snapshot fingerprint. Does not execute or dispatch. SSL5_PLAN_SCHEMA_VERSION and session-snapshot schemaVersion stay 1.
